scripts.build: node -e "console.log('Build started:', new Date().toLocaleString())" && npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine-dsim && node scripts/tooling/vite-realpath.mjs build
scripts.build:web: node -e "console.log('Build started:', new Date().toLocaleString())" && npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine-dsim && node scripts/tooling/vite-realpath.mjs build --mode web
scripts.typecheck: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine-dsim && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:scripts
scripts.postinstall: npm run ensure:wasm-toolchain && npx playwright install
scripts.test:unit: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && cargo test --manifest-path wasm/rule_engine_core/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path wasm/rule_engine_wasm/Cargo.toml && node scripts/test/run-tests.mjs
scripts.bench:pipeline: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/benchmarks/pipeline-perf.bench.js
scripts.repro:wasm-pipeline: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/repro-wasm-pipeline.js
scripts.repro:incremental-growth: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/repro-incremental-growth.js
scripts.repro:capture-replay: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/repro-capture-replay.js
scripts.probe:gear-inspector: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/gearInspectorProbe.js
scripts.repro:dup-collapse: npm run wasm:ensure:rule-engine && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node --experimental-wasm-modules --import ./tmp/tsc/tests/tests/setup/wasm-warmup.js tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/repro-duplicate-collapse.js
scripts.native-dll:realdata-input: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/native-dll-realdata-input.js
scripts.native-dll:parity-expected: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit false && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node tmp/tsc/tests/tests/repro/native-dll-parity-expected.js wasm/rule_engine_native/tests/fixtures/artifacts_packet.json wasm/rule_engine_native/tests/fixtures/champions_packet.json wasm/rule_engine_native/tests/fixtures/expected.json
scripts.native-dll:parity: npm run native-dll:parity-expected && cargo test --manifest-path wasm/Cargo.toml -p rule_engine_native
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all:full: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:full
scripts.tests:extract: tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node scripts/tooling/patch-esm-specifiers.cjs && node scripts/test/dump-tests-sfc.mjs
